items.title: File+
items.text: File+ is an advanced file upload template variable for MODX. A file can be uploaded directly in the template variable or selected in the media browser. The allowed file types and the upload path can be configured for each template variable.

items.title: Requirements
items.text:
• MODX Revolution 2.8+
  • PHP 8.2+

items.title: Features
items.text:
• Upload a file or select it in the media browser, integrated with the MODX Manager interface.
  • Restrict the allowed file types for each template variable.
  • Upload path with date, user, resource and template variable placeholders.
  • Optional title and description fields for the file.
  • Use a chunk as output mask and fill placeholders with the url, the filename, the file size, the title, the description etc. of the file.

items.title: Added
items.text:
• Initial release, based on the upload and media browser field of Image+ 3.0
  • File upload and media browser selection in the template variable
  • Allowed file types and upload path input options/system settings
  • Optional title and description fields
  • Output chunk with url, file, filename, extension, size, title and description placeholders
  • FilePlus snippet as alternative to the template variable output
  • FilePlus.ColumnRenderer for MIGX and Collections grids

items.title: Contributors

items.text: [[FilePlus? &value=`[[+file]]` &source=`2` &tpl=`FilePlus.file`]]

items.title: Create the template variable
items.text: Create a new template variable and select File+ as input type in the Input Options tab and as output type in the Output Options tab. Assign the template variable to the templates and select a media source in the Media Sources tab, if the files are not stored in the default media source.

items.title: Upload a file
items.text:
In the resource, the template variable shows a field with three buttons:

  • Clear: Remove the file from the template variable. The file is not deleted.
  • Upload: Upload a file from your computer into the upload path of the media source.
  • Browse: Select a file in the media browser.

The selected file is shown below the field with an icon of its file type and can be opened with a click.

items.title: Install from MODX Extras
items.text: Search for File+ in the Package Manager of your MODX installation and install it in there.

items.title: Manual installation
items.text:
If you can't access the MODX Extras Repository in your MODX installation, you can manually install File+.

  • Download the transport package from MODX Extras (or one of the pre-built transport packages in _packages)
  • Upload the zip file to your MODX installation's core/packages folder or upload it manually in the MODX Package Manager.
  • In the MODX Manager, navigate to the Package Manager page, and select 'Search locally for packages' from the dropdown button.
  • File+ should now show up in the list of available packages. Click the corresponding 'Install' button and follow the instructions to complete the installation.

items.title: Build it from source
items.text: To build and install the package from source you could use Git Package Management. The GitHub repository of File+ contains a config.json to build that package locally. Use this option, if you want to debug File+ and/or contribute bugfixes and enhancements.

items.title: Input options
items.text:
Option Description Default Allowed File Types A comma-separated list of the file extensions, that can be uploaded and selected, i.e. pdf,docx,zip. Overrides the fileplus.allowed_file_types system setting. The upload_files system setting Upload Path The path in the media source for uploaded files. Overrides the fileplus.upload_path system setting. The media source root Show Title Field Allow the user to enter a title for the file. No Show Description Field Allow the user to enter a description for the file. No

The upload path can contain the following placeholders: [[+year]], [[+month]], [[+day]], [[+user]], [[+username]], [[+resource_id]] and [[+tv_id]].

The file type and the upload path of an upload are checked with the options of the template variable on the server. The media source checks the file types in its allowedFileTypes property and the upload_files and upload_maxsize system settings additionally.

items.title: Output options
items.text: Option Description Output Chunk A chunk for the template variable output. Without a chunk, the url of the file is returned.

items.title: Placeholders
items.text:
The following placeholders are available in the output chunk:

Placeholder Description url URL of the file file Path of the file in the media source filename Filename with extension name Filename without extension extension File extension size File size in bytes (0 for files outside of the file system, i.e. in an S3 media source) size_formatted Formatted file size, i.e. 1.4 MB title Title description Description

items.title: Snippet
items.text:
The FilePlus snippet can be used as alternative to the template variable output.

Property Description Default tvname Name of the File+ template variable. - docid Resource where the template variable value is received from. Current resource value File+ value, i.e. of a MIGX field. Used instead of the template variable value. - source Media source ID, if the value is passed with the value property. Default media source tpl Template chunk for the snippet output. Without a template chunk, the URL of the file is returned. FilePlus.file 
[[FilePlus? &tvname=`download` &tpl=`FilePlus.file`]]

items.title: System settings
items.text: Key Description Default fileplus.allowed_file_types A comma-separated list of the file extensions, that can be uploaded and selected in the File+ template variables. - fileplus.upload_path The path in the media source for uploaded files. - fileplus.debug Log debug information in the MODX error log and load the unminified scripts. No

items.title: Template variable value
items.text:
The template variable value is a JSON encoded object:

{
  "file": "downloads/brochure.pdf",
  "title": "Brochure",
  "description": "Our brochure as PDF"
}

A plain file path (i.e. of a file template variable, that was changed to File+) is used as file without a title and a description.

items.title: MIGX and Collections
items.text: Use FilePlus.ColumnRenderer as renderer of a grid column to show the filename (or the title) of an File+ value.
